query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hunter_queue (
  id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  corporationId VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  searchType VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'apollo',
  searchData JSON,
  priority INT DEFAULT 5,
  status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'Pending',
  scheduledAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  startedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  completedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  contactsFound INT DEFAULT 0,
  errorMessage TEXT,
  metadata JSON,
  INDEX hunter_corporation_idx (corporationId),
  INDEX hunter_status_idx (status),
  INDEX hunter_priority_idx (priority)
)
